newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $2 bln for Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $2 bln for Tuesday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Tuesday are expected to total $2 billion in 49 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $1.1 billion in 25 sales, with a $180 million Allegheny County Sanitary Authority, Pa., through Commonwealth Securities topping the list.
On the competitive side, 24 sales totaling $970 million are scheduled. A $300 million Massachusettes deal at 1000 EDT is the largest.
An additional five sales totaling $274 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues Tuesady depending on market conditions.
